title: Measurement of Cellular Oxygen Consumption and Extracellular Acidification
author: Kiichi Hirota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.v92e98e

steps.title: Seed Cells
steps.instruction: Seed cells onto the XFp Cell Culture microplate and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Hydrate Sensor Cartridge
steps.instruction: Hydrate the XFp Analyzer sensor cartridge at 37 °C in a non-CO2 incubator one day before the experiment.

steps.title: Load Injection Ports
steps.instruction: Load the sensor cartridge injection ports with the following reagents at specified final concentrations:

substeps.instruction: Load port A with oligomycin (1 µM).
Load port B with carbonyl cyanide-p-trifluoromethoxyphenylhydrazone (FCCP; 2 µM).
Load port C with rotenone and antimycin A (0.5 µM each).

steps.title: Calibrate Sensor and Incubate Cells
steps.instruction: Incubate cells at 37 °C in a non-CO2 incubator during sensor calibration using 180 μl of assay medium.

substeps.instruction: Prepare assay medium (XF Base Medium) containing 25 mM glucose, 1 mM pyruvate, and 2 mM L-glutamine at pH 7.4.

steps.title: Initiate Assay
steps.instruction: Immediately place the plate on the calibrated XFp Analyzer to begin the assay.
